usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing cluster-wide storage definition — changing allowed content types, bandwidth limits, pruning policy, or toggling the storage disabled/enabled. Requires the Datastore.Allocate privilege at /storage. Changes are synchronous and take effect immediately across all nodes that have the storage configured; use the 'digest' param to guard against concurrent modifications when multiple operators may be editing storage config.

examples.summary: Update an NFS storage to allow backups and VM images, and set a 500 MiB/s restore bandwidth limit

tips: Pass 'delete' with a comma-separated list of param names to unset optional fields (e.g. 'delete=bwlimit,nodes' to remove per-storage bandwidth limits and node restrictions).
Setting 'disable=true' is a safe, reversible way to take a storage offline for maintenance without removing it from the cluster config.

The 'shared' flag does not replicate data — it only tells PVE that the storage is already shared at the infrastructure level (e.g. a SAN or NFS share). Misusing it on local storage can cause VM scheduling errors.
For PBS targets, the 'password' field updates the stored credential used for authentication against the Proxmox Backup Server datastore.
Retrieve the current 'digest' value from get_storage_storage before calling this endpoint if concurrent edits are a concern.
